| # Temperature monitoring {#temperature-monitoring-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The RC monitors periodically the temperature inside the housing.

At the temperature of 105°C, a warning will be generated by the BSW to the ASW (details see [\[RE95207\]](references.html#re_95207){.topiclink}, [\[RE95208\]](references.html#re_95208){.topiclink}). It is suggested to implement prevention method by the ASW (e.g. degrade the load current when possible) as reaction to the warning.  

If the temperature reaches the limit of 115°C, all power outputs will be switched off by the BSW to prevent unwanted behavior or concealed damage of the RC. Reactivation of the power outputs is only possible when the temperature falls below 105°C.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.
